interface.defaultPrompt: Use Unslop to audit this interface, propose a product-specific design direction, and refine it without changing its product features or content structure.
interface.longDescription: A design-review workflow adapted from heydamir/unslop. It audits a screen for generic AI-generated styling, proposes a product-specific direction before edits, guides a nine-pass refinement, and verifies the result. Original work by Damir Sokolovsky, CC BY 4.0.

name: unslop-ui-design
description: Audit and refine AI-looking interfaces into product-specific, intentional UI designs.
